# Implementation Plan: Plan 07 — Context preservation (notepad surfacing, per-task journal, RecentActivity sidebar, PR/branch backlinks)

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph --improve` on 2026-05-20. Improved against research findings. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan .ralph/jobs/ralph-pipeline-07-context/plan.md`.*

## Overview

Plans 01–05 give the dashboard the data it needs to show what's running and what just changed. This plan adds the **context surfaces** that answer two questions per task without round-tripping to other files:

1. **"What's stuck on this task?"** — surface the `notepad.md` Deferred Questions count + first-unanswered preview directly in the chip tooltip.
2. **"What just changed?"** — render the last 5–10 activity events in a right-side `RecentActivity` sidebar, click-through to navigate.

Plus two metadata enrichments: per-task journals (one line per stage transition, append-only) and PR/branch backlinks (chip tooltip → clickable PR URL + copy `git checkout <branch>`).

The plan is **disjoint** from Plan 06 (skills-worker) per parallel-safety rubric: Plan 06 only touches `scripts/lib/derive-next-command.mjs` and `.claude/skills/*` plus an additive `NextCommand` type on `types.ts`. Plan 07 extends `RalphPipelineState` with six new fields, modifies `sync-core.mjs`, and adds the new viewer surfaces.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context

Plan 07's "Read for reference" list survives verification on main HEAD `88464053`. Highlights from the parallel research:

- **`tools/overview-viewer/src/components/RalphStageChip.tsx` already exposes the `tooltipExtras?: ReactNode` prop** (Plan 03 shipped). The slot renders below the existing stage/slug/lastUpdatedAt rows: `{tooltipExtras ? <div>{tooltipExtras}</div> : null}`. **No change to RalphStageChip is needed** — Plan 07 only needs to *supply* the slot value from `TaskCommand.tsx`.
- **`tools/overview-viewer/src/components/TaskCommand.tsx` line 413** is the composition point: currently `<RalphStageChip taskId={task.id} ralphState={ralphState} />`. Existing helpers `QuickCopyButton`, `QuickNavButton`, `QuickActions`, and `copyTextWithToast` (lines 162–228) are the right primitives for the branch-copy and PR-link affordances.
- **`scripts/lib/sync-core.mjs` extension point** is `toPipelineState(bundle)` at lines 612–640. `readJobLikeBundles()` is the earlier point that already reads `job-state.json`, `prd.json`, optional `group.json`, review findings — Plan 07 extends it to also read `notepad.md` into the bundle and pass it through.
- **`mergeAndWrite()`** at line 239 returns `{ state, writtenAt, changedTaskIds, activityEvents }`. Activity events are derived but **not appended** by `mergeAndWrite()` itself — appending lives in the *callers* (`watch-ralph-state.mjs` watch loop and `scripts/sync-ralph-state.mjs` one-shot CLI). Journal appends piggyback on those same call sites, **before lock release**.
- **`scripts/lib/emit-activity.mjs`** is the canonical append+fsync pattern: `fs.openSync(path, 'a')` + `writeSync` + `fsyncSync` + `closeSync`. `append-journal.mjs` mirrors this.
- **`tools/overview-viewer/src/utils/commandNavigation.ts`** already exports `navigateToCommand(taskId, expandTask, …)`. `RecentActivity` reuses this — no new navigation plumbing needed.
- **HMR event** `'overview-ralph-state:update'` is emitted from `tools/overview-viewer/vite.config.ts` middleware (lines ~17, 157–159) and subscribed in `App.tsx` lines 75–84. `useActivityEvents` piggybacks on the same event.
- **`tools/overview-viewer/src/types.ts`** current `RalphPipelineState` fields (lines 61–75): `stage, entryPath, artifacts, jobSlug, groupSlug, isParallel, matchSource, storyCompletion, reviewOpenCount, hasPrdWorthy, terminalReason, lastUpdatedAt`. **None of Plan 07's six new fields exist yet.** `ActivityEvent` (lines 198–207) matches `deriveActivityEvents()` output exactly — Plan 07 reuses it verbatim.

Seeded from `--improve plans/ralph-pipeline-07-context.md`.

### Technical Constraints

1. **`plans/overview-activity.jsonl` may be absent on first load.** Plan 05's emitter creates it lazily on the first activity event. `RecentActivity` must render an empty state without crashing.
2. **Vite dev root is `tools/overview-viewer`.** A naked `fetch('./overview-activity.jsonl')` will NOT map to `plans/overview-activity.jsonl`. **A Vite middleware route is required**, mirroring how `/overview-ralph-state.js` is currently served in `vite.config.ts`.
3. **Static `plans/overview.html` opened via `file://` cannot `fetch()` neighboring files.** `useActivityEvents` must catch fetch errors and render the sidebar in a "no data" state — never crash the page.
4. **Use `execFileSync` for git commands** in `derive-pr-links.mjs`. Never shell-string interpolation (Windows safety + injection avoidance).
5. **`group.json` does NOT currently expose a `prUrl` field** in any of the existing samples (e.g. `.ralph/job-groups/overview-data-split/group.json`). The schema has `name, description, status, baseBranch, mergeStrategy, jobs, lastPhase, …`. `derive-pr-links.mjs` reads `groupState.prUrl` defensively (returns undefined if absent) and **always** runs the commit-message scrape fallback.
6. **Closes #N reconstruction:** the spec mentions deriving a GitHub PR URL from `Closes #N`. Reconstruct only when `git remote get-url origin` returns a parseable GitHub URL. Otherwise leave `prUrl` undefined (don't fabricate URLs).
7. **JSONL torn-line tolerance:** `useActivityEvents` and Node-side readers must skip the *last* line if it fails `JSON.parse` (still-being-written tail). Don't fail the whole load.
8. **TypeScript imports of root `.mjs` from tests** need adjacent `.d.mts` declarations; mirror the pattern in `tools/overview-viewer/src/__tests__/scripts.d.ts`.
9. **`SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA`** at `scripts/lib/emit-snapshot-schema.mjs` currently accepts extra fields, but for the generated contract we explicitly declare the six new optional Ralph fields. Otherwise downstream consumers (Plan 04 `recommendation` derivation, Plan 08 future work) may treat them as untyped.
10. **Plan 06 (skills-worker, possibly running in parallel)** does NOT touch `scripts/lib/sync-core.mjs` per its spec, nor any new file in this plan. The only shared file is `tools/overview-viewer/src/types.ts` — Plan 06 adds a `NextCommand` interface, Plan 07 extends `RalphPipelineState`. Bounded textual conflict on the interface body; union-of-fields resolves it cleanly. **Verify by reading `plans/ralph-pipeline-06-skills.md`** before doing the cascade.

## Approach

### Architecture

Three pure Node helpers feed enrichment data into `sync-core.mjs`'s per-bundle derivation:

```
.ralph/jobs/<slug>/notepad.md  ──►  parseNotepad()  ──┐
.ralph/job-groups/<slug>/group.json  ──►              ├──►  toPipelineState(bundle)
prd.json + derived stage + git log -n 5 <branch>  ──►  derivePRLinks({ stage, branchName }) ┘
                                                       │
                                                       ▼
                                            RalphPipelineState (6 new fields)
                                                       │
                                                       ▼
                                            overview-snapshot.json + sidecar
```

At the watcher and one-shot caller boundary, after `mergeAndWrite()` returns and `appendActivity` flushes to JSONL:

```
result.activityEvents.filter(e => e.changedFields.includes('stage'))
  ──►  appendJournalEntry({ repoRoot, taskId, line })  ──►  tasks/<taskId>/journal.md
```

On the viewer side, `App.tsx` mounts a new right sidebar component:

```
useActivityEvents()  ──►  fetch /overview-activity.jsonl (Vite middleware)
       │                   parse JSONL defensively (skip torn last line)
       │                   refetch on HMR event 'overview-ralph-state:update'
       ▼
<RecentActivity activityEvents={…} setFocusedTaskId={navigateToCommand}/>
```

Tooltip-extras composition in `TaskCommand.tsx` builds a JSX fragment with the new chip rows and passes it to `<RalphStageChip tooltipExtras={…} />` — using the slot already present in Plan 03's chip.

### Implementation Strategy

Eight stories, designed for **serial within this job** (each story builds on the previous types/exports). Suggested decomposition still produces a single cluster — see § Suggested Decomposition.

1. **US-001 — Parse notepad helper.** `scripts/lib/parse-notepad.mjs` + tests + fixtures. Pure function, no I/O. Lands first because the integration step depends on its export signature.
2. **US-002 — Derive PR-link helper.** `scripts/lib/derive-pr-links.mjs` + tests. Pure function with `execFileSync` for git; mock in tests.
3. **US-003 — Append-journal helper.** `scripts/lib/append-journal.mjs` + tests. File-write helper, mirror of `emit-activity.mjs` pattern. Path-traversal guard.
4. **US-004 — Extend `RalphPipelineState` + snapshot schema.** Additive only; typecheck must remain green.
5. **US-005 — Wire helpers into `sync-core.mjs` + watcher + one-shot CLI.** `readJobLikeBundles()` reads `notepad.md` into bundle. `toPipelineState()` calls `parseNotepad` + `derivePRLinks`. Both callers of `mergeAndWrite()` invoke `appendJournalEntry()` for stage-transition events.
6. **US-006 — `useActivityEvents` hook + Vite middleware.** Hook fetches `./overview-activity.jsonl`, parses JSONL defensively, refetches on HMR. Middleware in `vite.config.ts` serves `plans/overview-activity.jsonl` over the dev server.
7. **US-007 — `RecentActivity` sidebar + App integration + styles.** Right sidebar (collapsible). Click-through via `navigateToCommand`.
8. **US-008 — Tooltip extras composition in `TaskCommand.tsx`.** Build the JSX, pass through `tooltipExtras` prop. End-to-end test against a synthetic notepad fixture.

After all stories pass, the cascade refresh updates `plans/ralph-pipeline-INDEX.md` (or defers to `notepad.md` `## Deferred Cascade` if Plan 06 is still RUNNING at terminal time).

### Files to Create/Modify

#### Create

- `scripts/lib/parse-notepad.mjs` — exports `parseNotepad(notepadText) → { deferredQuestionsCount: number, deferredQuestionsPreview: string, storyDoctorInterventions: number }`. Markdown-table parser for the `## Deferred Questions` section per [implement-with-ralph Appendix B](C:/Users/evmitran/.claude/plugins/cache/ai-developer-toolkit/ralph-orchestration/5.41.0/skills/implement-with-ralph/SKILL.md). Counts rows with empty `Answer` column = unanswered. `deferredQuestionsPreview` is the first unanswered question's text, trimmed to 120 chars. `storyDoctorInterventions` counts non-empty data rows in `## Story Doctor Log` (separate section). Stderr-warn (deduped) on malformed table; return zero counts.
- `scripts/lib/parse-notepad.test.mjs` — vitest fixtures: (i) empty input, (ii) notepad without `## Deferred Questions`, (iii) 3 questions with 2 answered → count=1, (iv) malformed table → zero counts, (v) story-doctor-log row counting.
- `scripts/lib/parse-notepad.d.mts` — TypeScript declarations for the export.
- `scripts/lib/derive-pr-links.mjs` — exports `derivePRLinks({ groupState?, repoRoot, branchName, stage }) → { branchName?: string, prUrl?: string, mergeCommit?: string }`. The caller passes the `stage` derived in `toPipelineState()`; the helper does not infer shipped state from git. Reads `groupState?.prUrl` first (returns undefined if absent — `group.json` doesn't currently carry it, see Constraint 5). Fallback: `execFileSync('git', ['-C', repoRoot, 'log', '--format=%H%n%s%n%b', '-n', '5', branchName])` then regex scan for `https://github.com/.../pull/N` or `Closes #N`. For `Closes #N`, resolve via `git remote get-url origin` only when origin is a parseable GitHub URL. `mergeCommit` is resolved only when `stage === 'shipped'` and `branchName` is present: run `execFileSync('git', ['-C', repoRoot, 'rev-parse', branchName])` as a single-ref lookup, trim the full SHA, and shorten it in JS with `slice(0, 8)`. Wrap every `execFileSync` call in `try`/`catch`; missing/deleted branches, empty `git log` output, and origin-resolution failures return the known `branchName` with `prUrl` / `mergeCommit` left undefined rather than throwing.
- `scripts/lib/derive-pr-links.test.mjs` — vitest. Mock `execFileSync` to return canned `git log` output covering: direct URL match, `Closes #N` with resolvable origin, `Closes #N` without origin, branch with no PR reference, missing/deleted branch where `git log` throws, empty `git log` output, origin-resolution failure where `git remote get-url origin` throws, `mergeCommit` omitted for non-`shipped` stages, and `mergeCommit` populated for `shipped` via single-ref `rev-parse` shortened in JS.
- `scripts/lib/derive-pr-links.d.mts` — declarations.
- `scripts/lib/append-journal.mjs` — exports `appendJournalEntry({ repoRoot, taskId, line })`. Validates the resolved path stays under `<repoRoot>/tasks/<taskId>/journal.md` (path-traversal guard — reject taskIds containing `/`, `\`, or `..`). Creates the directory + file on first call. Uses `fs.openSync(path, 'a')` + `writeSync` + `fsyncSync` + `closeSync` (mirror of `emit-activity.mjs` lines 7–34). Line format: `- <ISO timestamp>  stage: <prev> → <new>  (job: <slug>)\n`.
- `scripts/lib/append-journal.test.mjs` — vitest. Two appends produce two lines. Directory-creation idempotency. Path-traversal rejection.
- `scripts/lib/append-journal.d.mts` — declarations.
- `tools/overview-viewer/src/components/RecentActivity.tsx` — props `{ activityEvents: ActivityEvent[]; setFocusedTaskId: (id: string) => void }`. Renders the last 5–10 events (newest first), each a clickable button: `<taskId> → <newStage>` + relative timestamp. Empty state: `<aside className="recent-activity-sidebar empty">No recent activity yet.</aside>`. Collapsible (controlled by parent).
- `tools/overview-viewer/src/hooks/useActivityEvents.ts` — fetches `./overview-activity.jsonl?t=<Date.now()>` (cache-bust), parses JSONL line-by-line; on `JSON.parse` failure of the *last* line only, skip silently (torn write); on failure of an interior line, console.warn and skip. Subscribes to `import.meta.hot.on('overview-ralph-state:update', refetch)`; unsubscribes on unmount. Returns `ActivityEvent[]` newest-first.

## Scope

### In Scope

- Six new optional fields on `RalphPipelineState`: `deferredQuestionsCount`, `deferredQuestionsPreview`, `storyDoctorInterventions`, `branchName`, `prUrl`, `mergeCommit`.
- The three Node helpers (`parse-notepad`, `derive-pr-links`, `append-journal`) with vitest coverage.
- `sync-core.mjs` integration in both `readJobLikeBundles()` and `toPipelineState()`.
- Journal append in BOTH watch-mode (`watch-ralph-state.mjs`) AND one-shot mode (`scripts/sync-ralph-state.mjs`), inside the sync lock window.
- Snapshot schema update.
- `RecentActivity` sidebar + `useActivityEvents` hook + Vite middleware for `/overview-activity.jsonl`.
- Tooltip-extras composition at the `TaskCommand` layer using the existing Plan 03 `tooltipExtras` slot.
- INDEX cascade refresh (or deferred cascade if Plan 06 in flight).

### Out of Scope

- Crews session list in tooltip → Plan 08.
- MCP `overview.add_journal_entry` tool wrapping `append-journal.mjs` → Plan 09.
- Full notepad rendering (deferred-questions table viewer, story-doctor-log dialog) → not in v1; tooltip is sufficient.
- Modifying `RalphStageChip.tsx` itself — Plan 03's `tooltipExtras` slot is contract-stable.
- Writing PR URLs into `OverviewData.runs[]` — `runs[]` stays bookkeeper-owned (Plan 07's PR URLs go into `RalphPipelineState.prUrl` only).
- Web Workers / streaming JSONL — small dataset (≤1000 events post-rotation), inline parsing is fine.

## Risk Areas

1. **Vite middleware ordering** — the middleware that serves `/overview-activity.jsonl` must be registered *before* the SPA fallback. Mirror the existing pattern for `/overview-ralph-state.js` (see `vite.config.ts` lines ~140–160).
2. **JSONL race during sync** — Plan 05's `appendActivity` is fsync'd, so a snapshot read mid-write should see either zero new lines or a complete new line. The torn-line tolerance in `useActivityEvents` is belt-and-braces protection.
3. **`group.json.prUrl` is currently undefined** — Plan 07 documents that the field is consumed defensively. If a future orchestrator change starts populating it, Plan 07's code reads it correctly without modification.
4. **Path-traversal in `appendJournalEntry`** — explicit guard against taskIds containing `/`, `\`, `..` is mandatory. Test covers rejection.
5. **HMR teardown** — `useActivityEvents` must call `import.meta.hot?.off(...)` on unmount, including under React StrictMode double-invocation. Plan 07's hook mirrors the App.tsx subscription pattern.
6. **Snapshot schema strictness** — if `SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA` is referenced by an external validator in CI, the additive fields must be declared optional to avoid breakage. Verify by running `pnpm test` for the schema test (`emit-snapshot.test.mjs`).
7. **Parallel-safety with Plan 06** — both extend `types.ts`. Bounded merge conflict; resolve by union of fields. Plan 06's footprint is otherwise disjoint (confirmed against `plans/ralph-pipeline-06-skills.md`).
8. **Vite middleware mime / static `file://` opening** — the production build inlines data; for `plans/overview.html` opened directly via `file://`, fetch will fail. `useActivityEvents` swallows the error and renders empty state. This is acceptable degradation for a dev tool.
9. **Cascade timing vs Plan 06** — the cascade audit at the end of Phase 5 must check whether Plan 06 has reached terminal state. If not, defer cascade entries to `<jobDir>/notepad.md` under `## Deferred Cascade` rather than touching `plans/ralph-pipeline-INDEX.md` concurrently.

## Verification

A. **Notepad parser fixtures (AC-1):** vitest cases — empty notepad, notepad without `## Deferred Questions`, 3 questions with 2 answered → count=1 + preview is the unanswered question text, malformed table → zero counts + stderr warn observed, story-doctor-log row counting (2 non-empty rows → `storyDoctorInterventions=2`).

B. **PR scraping (AC-2):** vitest with mocked `execFileSync` — `git log` returns commit body containing `https://github.com/foo/bar/pull/42` → `prUrl='https://github.com/foo/bar/pull/42'`. Body with `Closes #42` and origin `https://github.com/foo/bar.git` → `prUrl='https://github.com/foo/bar/pull/42'`. Body with `Closes #42` and no parseable origin → `prUrl=undefined`. Empty body → `prUrl=undefined`. Missing branch where `git log` throws → `{ branchName, prUrl: undefined, mergeCommit: undefined }`. Origin lookup throwing during `Closes #N` reconstruction → `prUrl=undefined`. With `stage !== 'shipped'`, `mergeCommit=undefined` and no `rev-parse` call is made. With `stage === 'shipped'`, `git rev-parse <branchName>` returns a full SHA and the helper returns its first 8 chars; if `rev-parse` throws, `mergeCommit=undefined`.

C. **Journal append (AC-3, AC-7):** flip a synthetic job's stage via `.ralph/jobs/<test>/job-state.json` edit. After sync, `tail tasks/<id>/journal.md` shows `- <ts>  stage: <prev> → <new>  (job: <slug>)`. Run sync twice → two lines. Inject taskId `../etc/passwd` → helper throws.

D. **Branch surfacing (AC-11):** for a task with `prd.branch.name='ralph/overview-data-split/integration'`, the chip tooltip shows that branch name plus a `QuickCopyButton` whose tooltip is "Copy `git checkout ralph/overview-data-split/integration`". Click → toast confirms copy.

E. **RecentActivity render (AC-8):** open the dev server (`pnpm --filter @codexu/overview-viewer dev`), expand the right sidebar. Last 5–10 events render newest-first, each with a clickable task ID. Click → command list scrolls to that task and expands it.

F. **Tooltip detail (AC-11):** populate a synthetic notepad with 3 deferred questions (2 answered). Run sync. Hover the chip — tooltip shows "📝 1 open questions" and a preview of the unanswered question (truncated at 120 chars).

G. **Tooltip empty fallback (AC-12):** hover a chip for a task with no notepad / no branch / no PR. Tooltip shows only the Plan 03 minimal content (stage, jobSlug, lastUpdatedAt). No empty rows, no console warnings.

H. **HMR refresh (AC-9):** with Plan 02's watcher running, edit a job's `job-state.json` to flip stage. RecentActivity sidebar updates within ~2–3 seconds with the new event at the top.

I. **Vite middleware (AC-10):** `curl http://localhost:<port>/overview-activity.jsonl` returns the JSONL content. Move/remove the file; `curl` returns `200 ''` (empty body), not 404.

J. **Snapshot schema (AC-5):** `pnpm test` for `emit-snapshot.test.mjs` passes; an extra test asserts `validateSnapshot` does NOT reject a snapshot with the new optional fields populated.

K. **Cascade (AC-15):** read `plans/ralph-pipeline-06-skills.md` to confirm Plan 06's actual footprint (sync-core untouched). Check whether `.ralph/jobs/ralph-pipeline-06-skills/` has `terminal: true` in its progress; if NOT, defer cascade and add a `## Deferred Cascade` entry to `notepad.md`. If yes, update INDEX in the final commit.

## Preliminary Story Decomposition

Eight stories, executed serially in this single-job plan. See § Suggested Decomposition for cluster JSON.

- **US-001 — parse-notepad helper.** Pure, no I/O. Tests are vitest fixtures. ~1 hour.
- **US-002 — derive-pr-links helper.** `execFileSync` for git; mock in tests. ~1.5 hours.
- **US-003 — append-journal helper.** `fs.openSync(…, 'a')` + path-traversal guard. ~1 hour.
- **US-004 — types.ts + snapshot schema extension.** Additive; typecheck green. ~30 min.
- **US-005 — sync-core + watcher + one-shot CLI wiring.** Both callers symmetric. ~2 hours.
- **US-006 — useActivityEvents hook + Vite middleware.** Includes ENOENT graceful path. ~1.5 hours.
- **US-007 — RecentActivity sidebar + App integration + styles.** Collapsible right column. ~2 hours.
- **US-008 — Tooltip extras composition + E2E.** Final integration; populate fixture + hover-test. ~1.5 hours.
- **US-009 — Cascade refresh.** INDEX update (or deferred cascade in notepad). ~30 min.

## Suggested Decomposition

This plan is intentionally serial — every story builds on the export signature, type, or call site of the previous one. Cluster topology is a single cluster running in phase 1; no parallel execution is recommended.

### Cluster: plan07-context-serial

- Stories: US-001, US-002, US-003, US-004, US-005, US-006, US-007, US-008, US-009
- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[`tools/overview-viewer/src/types.ts`, `scripts/lib/sync-core.mjs`, `tools/overview-viewer/src/App.tsx`, `tools/overview-viewer/src/components/TaskCommand.tsx`, `tools/overview-viewer/src/styles.css`, `tools/overview-viewer/vite.config.ts`]; exclusive=[the new helpers under `scripts/lib/parse-notepad.mjs`, `scripts/lib/derive-pr-links.mjs`, `scripts/lib/append-journal.mjs`, `tools/overview-viewer/src/components/RecentActivity.tsx`, `tools/overview-viewer/src/hooks/useActivityEvents.ts`]; risk=medium (multiple core files modified, but in a chained dependency order rather than parallel-safe).
- `execution_mode` rationale: Each story's tests and acceptance criteria depend on types/exports introduced by the previous story (e.g. US-005 imports from US-001/002/003). Splitting into parallel clusters would require synthetic dependency edges across nearly every story pair, and the total footprint is small enough (~10 hours sequential) that the orchestration overhead of parallelism outweighs any gain.

Parallel handoff: `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan .ralph/jobs/ralph-pipeline-07-context/plan.md --parallel --suggested-decomposition .ralph/jobs/ralph-pipeline-07-context/suggested-decomposition.json` (NOT recommended — see rationale above). Prefer serial: `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan .ralph/jobs/ralph-pipeline-07-context/plan.md --autonomous`.

## Open Questions

1. **Should `storyDoctorInterventions` count include resolved entries?** Spec is ambiguous. Current decision: count all non-empty data rows in `## Story Doctor Log`, regardless of resolution status. Revisit in Plan 08 if needed.
2. **Should the RecentActivity sidebar persist its collapsed state across reloads?** Plan currently does NOT add localStorage persistence — collapse defaults to closed in compact density mode, open otherwise. If user feedback requests persistence, add a follow-up story in Plan 08+.
3. **`prUrl` reconstruction for `Closes #N`** — current decision: only reconstruct when `git remote get-url origin` returns a parseable GitHub URL. For Azure DevOps / GitLab / other remotes, leave `prUrl` undefined. Plan 08 may extend the matcher.
4. **Should journal entries be auto-appended for `changedFields` other than `stage`?** Current decision: stage-only (matches Plan 07's "stage transitions" wording). Other field changes are visible via the RecentActivity sidebar's `changedFields` payload but don't trigger a journal write.
5. **Group.json `prUrl` source-of-truth** — `derive-pr-links.mjs` reads `groupState.prUrl` defensively. If/when the orchestrator starts writing this field, Plan 07 will pick it up automatically. No follow-up needed in this plan.

### Remaining Medium plan-review findings (soft-cap at iteration 5)

Plan review reached soft-cap with 0 Critical/High open and 9 Medium open. Implementation may proceed; the implementer should address these inline:

- **F-005 (Completeness, claude)** — Vite middleware placement: add a new `overviewActivityPlugin()` modelled on `overviewRalphStatePlugin()` (`enforce="pre"`), registered in `plugins:` before the SPA fallback. On ENOENT, respond `res.statusCode = 200; res.end('')`.
- **F-006 (Criteria Quality, consensus)** — AC-15 cascade detection: read `.ralph/jobs/ralph-pipeline-06-skills/progress.json`. Plan 06 is terminal if `progress.terminal === true` OR the directory contains only `plan.md`. Otherwise defer cascade to `notepad.md` `## Deferred Cascade`.
- **F-007 (Criteria Quality, consensus)** — Split AC-6 into AC-6a (notepad fields from 3-question fixture), AC-6b (`branchName` from `prd.branch.name`), AC-6c (`prUrl` from mocked `Closes #N` + resolvable origin), AC-6d (`mergeCommit` only when stage=`shipped`), AC-6e (no sync failure when branch absent).
- **F-008 (Completeness, copilot)** — `appendJournalEntry` signature: change to `{ repoRoot, taskId, ts, prevStage, newStage, slug }` and format internally; export `formatJournalLine(...)` for test introspection.
- **F-009 (Completeness, copilot)** — RecentActivity props: either add `{ collapsed: boolean; onToggle: () => void }`, or own collapse state internally seeded from a `density` prop.
- **F-010 (Completeness, codex)** — Render contract for null `newStage`: show `<taskId> removed` rather than `<taskId> → null`. Add a fixture-based render test.
- **F-011 (Simplicity, consensus)** — Skip git invocations entirely when `branchName` is falsy. Memoize `git remote get-url origin` per sync pass at the assembly layer and pass resolved origin URL into `derivePRLinks`. Always wrap git calls in try/catch.
- **F-012 (Completeness, codex)** — Add unit tests in `scripts/lib/watch-ralph-state.test.mjs` and `scripts/sync-ralph-state.test.mjs` that mock `appendJournalEntry` and verify invocation per stage-changed activity event.
- **F-013 (Completeness, copilot)** — Also update `scripts/lib/sync-core.d.mts` (if a typed bundle shape is exported) to include the new optional `notepadText` field. Verify by `pnpm --filter @codexu/overview-viewer typecheck`.
